verdicts.reason: A has a clear hierarchy, with a dominant headline and the CTA sitting next to the body copy. But it drops the terrazzo confetti background entirely, which is a big fidelity loss. The book cover and logo are shrunk to small top-row thumbnails, and the legal line is very small. B keeps the confetti strip and a big book cover, but it breaks the reading order: the '24 HOURS, 24 READERS' kicker sits below the body copy. Its Inkwell & Lantern logo is a tiny, illegible mark jammed into the bottom-left corner on top of the confetti, and the legal text floats in a large empty band at the bottom.
